```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "scales"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- scenario_evppi_path()
if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
  stop(
    "Full scenario cache not found: ", cache_file, ". Run ",
    "scripts/R/analysis/12_scenario_EVPPIs.R before rendering Figure 5."
  )
}
evppi_cache <- readRDS(cache_file)

evppi_grouped <- data.frame()
if (!is.null(evppi_cache) && nrow(evppi_cache$evppi_all_scenarios) > 0) {
  evppi_all <- evppi_cache$evppi_all_scenarios

  if (!"evppi_population_millions" %in% names(evppi_all)) {
    discounted_pop <- annual_incidence_norway *
      sum(1 / (1 + discount_rate_research)^(0:(research_horizon_years - 1)))
    evppi_all$evppi_population_millions <- evppi_all$evppi * discounted_pop / 1e6
  }

  scenario_labels <- c(
    base = "Base case",
    s1_decreased_nivo = "Biosimilar pricing",
    s2_wtp100k = "WTP 100,000"
  )

  evppi_grouped <- evppi_all %>%
    filter(scenario_id %in% names(scenario_labels)) %>%
    mutate(param_group = case_when(
      parameter %in% c("c_drug_nivo", "c_drug_FLOX") ~ "Drug costs",
      parameter %in% c("u_np", "u_p") ~ "Utilities",
      parameter %in% c("p_crp", "p_tmb_braf") ~ "Biomarker prevalence",
      grepl("^b_(crp|tmb_braf)", parameter) ~ "Biomarker-treatment interaction",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*drug", parameter) ~ "Drug costs",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*util", parameter) ~ "Utilities",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*prevalence", parameter) ~ "Biomarker prevalence",
      grepl("^\\[GROUP\\].*interaction", parameter) ~ "Biomarker-treatment interaction",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(param_group)) %>%
    group_by(param_group, scenario_id) %>%
    summarise(evppi_pop = sum(evppi_population_millions, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = factor(scenario_labels[scenario_id], levels = scenario_labels))
}
```

```{r figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  group_order <- evppi_grouped %>%
    group_by(param_group) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(evppi_pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(total) %>%
    pull(param_group)

  evppi_grouped$param_group <- factor(evppi_grouped$param_group, levels = group_order)

  p_evppi <- ggplot(evppi_grouped, aes(x = param_group, y = evppi_pop, fill = Scenario)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0("EUR ", format(x, big.mark = ","), "M")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Population EVPPI (EUR millions)", fill = "Scenario") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  print(p_evppi)
} else {
  cat("Scenario EVPPI cache not available. Run scripts/R/analysis/12_scenario_EVPPIs.R first.")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (exists("p_evppi")) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  ggsave(here("figs", "figure5.png"), p_evppi, width = 9, height = 6,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

Figure 5 has been saved to `figs/figure5.png`.
